spec: C05-BUILD-SPEC.md 交付物 8 (单消费者 throw)
description: Reuses the existing read-only fixture ../index-emit-file-empty (B4, 补遗一第 10 条①) — its decisions.md is 0 bytes, the other 6 ALL_FILES are well-formed. pmm-index-emit.cjs has a DEDICATED fileFaults() structural check that fires before parseAll() and degrades with file-empty:decisions.md. pmm-hook.cjs has NO such check: core.snapshot('worktree') treats a 0-byte file as present-but-empty (missing=false), core.analyze() parses it as a file with zero entries, and the hook proceeds normally with isMemory=true and no degraded field. Empirically confirmed via isolated probe before writing this fixture (see builder report). This is the concrete demonstration of '单消费者 throw': the SAME fault input degrades exactly one of the two consumers.
